lines.en: It's Monday. I'm not feeling well.
lines.zh: 今天是星期一，我不太舒服。

lines.en: I have a headache and a cough.
"Sorry, I need to see a doctor today."
lines.zh: "不好意思，我今天要去看医生。"

lines.en: There is a long queue at the clinic.
The nurse is very kind.
"Is it serious?"
"I need an MC, please."
I take a taxi home. I need to rest.
lines.zh: 我坐的士回家，要好好休息。

lines.en: I have a message from my friend.
"Get well soon!"
"Thank you! I will drink more water."

dialogue.title: 周末约不成了
dialogue.setting: 星期六早上，朋友 Mei 打电话约 Amy 星期天出去，可是 Amy 生病了。

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: Hi Amy! What is your plan for Sunday?
lines.zh: 嗨 Amy！你星期天有什么安排？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, I'm sick.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: Oh no! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I have a fever and a sore throat.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: Do you need medicine?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: No, thank you. I have medicine.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: You need to rest.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes. Can we meet next Sunday?
lines.zh: 嗯。我们下个星期天见面好吗？

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: Sure! I will send you the location.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you, Mei.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.en: Get well soon!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you. I will text you later.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我晚点发信息给你。
